response.overview: The material of the piece is a found image—a photograph shot on a film positive in the 1950s, with faded colors and a scratched surface. The work directs the gaze away from the subject matter of the photograph and focuses intently on the edges of the image. It hovers beside the subject; on one hand, the gaze looks past it, while a new  image is created.
response.tagline: Investigation on the borders and edges of a single photographic image
response.title: Channel
